title: Cheapest cached fare
description: One record: the cheapest fare a fare cache holds for one route and one departure month, as seen when it was fetched (a time series per route-month). Not a live, bookable price. Voyager use: pricing advisor, budget planner and fare-calendar context (typical fares and their trend).

origin_iata.description: Origin city or airport IATA code as queried.

destination_iata.description: Destination city or airport IATA code as queried.

origin_airport.description: Departure airport IATA code of the fare.

destination_airport.description: Arrival airport IATA code of the fare.

price.description: The cheapest cached price, exactly as published (whole trip, one adult).

trip_type.description: round_trip when the fare has a return date.

return_date.description: Return date of the fare (YYYY-MM-DD), round trips only.

duration_min.description: Total flight duration in minutes, as published.

found_at.description: When the cache found this price (ISO 8601), if the source gives it.

search_url.description: The source's own search link for this fare (carries no affiliate marker; the app adds one when it links out).

publisher.description: Who publishes the cache (e.g. "Travelpayouts / Aviasales Data API").

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
